changes.title: Web UI Design Guidelines — dark theme, no AI slop

commit.message:
Add web UI design guidelines — dark theme tokens, no AI-slop anti-patterns

Captures the landing-page redesign brief (PR #442) as a permanent
context document so future page revamps (/solve/, /problems/, /algorithms/,
/blog/) reuse the same palette, typography, and anti-pattern checklist
instead of re-deriving them.
